definitions.explanation: Physically demanding or exhausting work. Can also be used figuratively for mentally taxing work that feels overwhelming.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{重|じゅう}{労働|ろうどう}だ。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{重|じゅう}{労働|ろうどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ボロボロだ。
examples.english: My body is falling apart from heavy labor every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{肉体的|にくたいてき}→肉体的：06198_nikutaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{重|じゅう}{労働|ろうどう}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Caregiving work is said to be hard labor both mentally and physically.

notes:
USAGE:
Can describe literal heavy physical work or be used figuratively for any extremely demanding task. Often used emphatically in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重|じゅう}{労働|ろうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|し}いられる→強いる：15604_shiiru⟧ (to be forced into hard labor)
- {重|じゅう}{労働|ろうどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ (to endure hard labor)
- ⟦{肉体的|にくたいてき}→肉体的：06198_nikutaiteki⟧な{重|じゅう}{労働|ろうどう} (physically demanding labor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肉体|にくたい}{労働|ろうどう}→肉体労働：22825_nikutairoudou⟧: physical labor — emphasizes it being bodily work, not necessarily exhausting
- {過重|かじゅう}⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧: overwork — excessive work hours, a social issue in Japan
